source_read_supplement.contents: GJR7.9 precise ordinary local LFS presentation; Proposition7.10 complete nef-to-LFS uniform approximation proof with its interior hypothesis; Remark7.11 is not granted as theorem;7.14 current positivity proof is distinct from an ordinal-stage conclusion.

exact_scope: LFS belongs locally to CD-v2 ordinal stage1. A finite semipositive real-PL function belongs locally to stage2 at interior points by a common-neighborhood uniform-to-decreasing conversion. No regularized-supremum theorem is proved.
